# Gastrointestinal

This folder catalogs the primary gastrointestinal conditions tracked by the Danish national quality database for inflammatory bowel disease (DANIBD). It covers the broad clinical framework of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) alongside its two main subtypes, Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis. The pages detail the epidemiological prevalence, demographic breakdowns, and specific registry inclusion criteria for these conditions across Danish hospital departments.

## Pages

- [[colitis-ulcerosa|Colitis ulcerosa]] — Details the epidemiology and registry inclusion criteria for ulcerative colitis, noting it accounts for 58% of newly diagnosed adult IBD cases in Denmark.
- [[crohns-sygdom|Crohns sygdom]] — Covers Crohn's disease, highlighting its status as the most frequent pediatric IBD diagnosis and the clinical importance of post-operative follow-up.
- [[inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Inflammatoriske tarmsygdomme]] — Provides the overarching clinical and epidemiological framework for IBD in Denmark, estimating nearly 70,000 patients live with the condition.
